# datagrids

> Framework-agnostic, zero-dependency, accessible data grid that enhances plain HTML tables. A small core with
> typed columns plus independent modules attached with `use` (no giant options object), three server protocols
> (classic SSP wire incl. the yajra preset, Laravel paginator JSON, datagrids protocol v1) and styling isolated
> under `--dg-*` tokens. npm: @akinozgen17/datagrids

Key facts:
- Install: `npm i @akinozgen17/datagrids` and `import "@akinozgen17/datagrids/css"` (required)
- Init: `new Datagrid(table, { label, columns, use: [modules] })`; put the data source in `use`
- `Datagrid.get(table)` returns the instance or `null`; it never initializes
- Cells render as text; HTML is a per-column opt-in (the `yajra()` preset defaults untyped columns to HTML)
- Types are the source of truth: `dist/index.d.ts`; the full API cheat sheet ships as `docs/llm.md`

## Start here
